basis: The dashboard title 'Global Energy Consumption by Source' defines the scope. The pie chart inscriptions provide the shares: Fossil Fuels (50%), Renewables (25%), Nuclear (15%), and Hydroelectric (10%). Fossil Fuels has the greatest percentage (50%), making it the largest global energy consumption category. The task instruction and the 'Routing criterion' field require routing this largest category to priority source monitoring. The option 'Route Fossil Fuels to priority source monitoring' names the identified category and matches the required action.
option_label: Route Fossil Fuels to priority source monitoring
